entry_item.definition: adv. and postpos. Together, along with, jointly, simultaneously.

example.definition: Together, jointly, collectively; simultaneously; along with.
To enter or join together; to take part or share together.
To live or stay together; to cohabit.

entry_item.definition: T. lhan cig; S. saha. Together, simultaneous.

example.definition: T. lhan cig (tu) byung ba; S. sahaja. Born simultaneously, coexistent. Especially applied to a genius protector supposed to be born and existing simultaneously with an exalted person, such as the Bu. and charged with accompanying him through all his life, according to popular belief. In India this belief was extended even to the certain exclusive possessions of such a person. Legend gave a genius protector also to Sagjamuni. Here he was later identified with Vacirbani (see γar tegen vacirtu). For the objects co-existent with the Bu. see erdeni, dolu) an. The idea expressed by xamtu nigen boluγsan or tørygsen gained a deeper significance in esoterism where it is sometimes described as the mysterious realization of the ultimate innate 'it' of the self and the nom ud.
T. lhan cig (tu) skyes pa; S. sahaja. See xamtu nigen boluγsan.
